Notes.Name: Get User’s Desktop Path
Notes.Details: Check the User Shell Folders registry keys for the path to the user’s desktop. This is better than using environmental variables as they may be using folder redirects.

Notes.Name: Get Folder Path of the Current Script
Notes.Details: Returns the path of the script being executed. If unavailable, it will return the path of the PowerShell console.

Notes.Name: Create a Folder Share
Notes.Details: Return all the domain and forest level FSMO roles.

Notes.Name: Create Folder If It Doesn’t Exist
Notes.Details: Check if a folder path exists using the Test-Path and if it doesn’t create the folder using New-Item
